revisionDesc.change: Vote - Accept-Straight-to-Finalization - Disregard lin8 Ἁγίωνος. lin15 Ἀπ[ί]α preferable to Ἀτία because of spacing. lin18 [Ἀ]μ̣[α]ζ̣όνιον good. lin27 enter <:Σκαπλᾶς=N. Gonis, BASP 58 (2021) 389|ed|Ἑκαπλᾶς:>. BLs good.

Vote - DEFER - lin8 Ἁγίωνος could be kept; cf. BASP 49 (2012) 130 and n. 39. || lin15 Rather Ἀπ[ί]α? || lin18 [Ἀ]μ̣[α]ζ̣όνιον is good; cf. P.Oxy. XII 1542.6 || lin27 the correction has already been made: <:Σκαπλᾶς=N. Gonis, BASP 58 (2021) 389|ed|Ἑκαπλᾶς:>. — Next voter.
Submit - Integration of BL 11 and further name corrections.

Commit - I've integrated corr. from BL 11 for lines 19 and 40. Further name corrections: lin8 Ἁγίωνος => Ἀτίωνος, lin15 Ἁγία => Ἀτία, lin18 [.1]μ̣[.1].1ονιον => [Ἀ]μ̣[α]ζ̣όνιον, lin27 Ἑκαπλᾶς => Σκαπλᾶς (cf. P.Graux 2.9). For lin32, I've added a regularization of φλουμάρης (l. πλουμάριος), cf. ed. n. 32.
